projects.title: 3-Digit 7-Segment Display PCB with ADC Test Circuit (Designed in Eagle)
projects.description:
Designed and developed a custom 3-digit 7-segment display PCB using Autodesk Eagle, on which a standalone ADC test circuit was implemented and validated.

The PCB was primarily created for driving a 3-digit common-cathode 7-segment display, and the ADC block was added on the same board to test and verify analog signal measurement.
The ADC section was used to read external analog inputs and evaluate signal stability and accuracy before further system integration.

Both the display driver circuitry and ADC test circuit were designed with proper grounding, signal routing, and component placement to ensure reliable operation.

projects.title: 3-Digit 7-Segment Display PCB with EEPROM Test Circuit (Designed in Eagle)
projects.description:
Designed and developed a custom 3-digit 7-segment display PCB using Autodesk Eagle, on which a standalone EEPROM test circuit was implemented and validated.

The PCB was primarily designed to drive a 3-digit common-cathode 7-segment display, and the EEPROM block was added on the same board to test non-volatile data storage functionality.
The EEPROM was used to store and retrieve configuration and test data, ensuring data retention even after power loss.

Both the display driver circuitry and EEPROM test circuit were carefully designed with proper routing, grounding, and connector access to ensure reliable operation and easy microcontroller interfacing.

projects.title: A7670C GSM Module – Outgoing Call Testing using UART
projects.description:
Performed outgoing phone call testing on the A7670C GSM module using UART communication and AT command protocols via Tera Term.

The GSM module was configured over UART, and AT commands were used to dial predefined mobile numbers and control call initiation.
Tera Term was used to send commands, monitor serial responses, and verify successful call setup and network connectivity.

This project focused on validating GSM outgoing call functionality, UART communication reliability, and AT command execution, which are essential for embedded GSM-based alert and notification systems.

projects.title: A7670C GSM Module – SMS Testing using UART
projects.description:
Performed SMS (Short Message Service) functionality testing on the A7670C GSM module using UART communication and AT command protocols.

The module was interfaced via UART and tested using serial terminal software to send AT commands for SMS configuration, message sending, and response verification.
The testing focused on ensuring reliable GSM communication, correct message delivery, and proper handling of serial responses.

This project provided hands-on experience in GSM SMS operation, UART-based debugging, and AT command flow, which are essential for embedded GSM and IoT communication systems.

projects.title: A7670C GSM Module – MQTT Publish Testing using UART
projects.description:
Performed MQTT publish functionality testing on the A7670C GSM module using UART communication and AT command control.

The GSM module was configured for packet data connection (GPRS/LTE) and tested to publish data to an MQTT broker using AT commands sent over UART.
Serial terminal software was used to monitor command responses, verify successful network attachment, MQTT connection, and data publish acknowledgment.

This testing focused on understanding MQTT protocol flow, GSM-based data communication, and UART-based debugging, which are essential for IoT and remote monitoring applications.

projects.title: A7670C GSM Module – MQTT Subscribe Testing using UART
projects.description:
Performed MQTT subscribe functionality testing on the A7670C GSM module using UART communication and AT command control.

The module was configured to establish a packet data connection (GPRS/LTE) and connect to an MQTT broker.
Using UART-based AT commands, the module was subscribed to specific MQTT topics and tested for receiving incoming messages in real time.

Serial terminal software was used to monitor responses, validate successful broker connection, topic subscription, and message reception, ensuring reliable GSM-based MQTT communication.

projects.title: Multi-Language Dot Matrix Display System using Python, PIC18F26K40, MQTT & A7672S GSM Module
projects.description:
Developed a multi-language dot matrix display system capable of displaying text in any language, using a combination of Python software, PIC18F26K40 microcontroller, MQTT protocol, and A7672S GSM module.

The system allows text input from a Python application, which processes the characters and converts them into bitmap / binary dot-matrix data.
The processed data is transmitted via MQTT, using the A7672S GSM module for cellular connectivity.

The PIC18F26K40 microcontroller subscribes to the MQTT topic, receives the display data, and drives the dot matrix display to render the text in real time.
This architecture enables remote, language-independent text updates over GSM networks.
